### Item 6 — problem tree

Problems: Q0 weekly payment for 2026-09-12 (root); Q1 dependency disallowance; Q2 waiting-week entry for 2026-09-05; Q3 claimant phone certification of 2026-09-12 (user).

- Q0 → Q2 (state-derived): weekly-payment hub "A weekly payment is not fixed until the claim carries a waiting-week entry for the first otherwise-payable week of its benefit year." Ledger has no waiting-week entry; week 2026-09-05 is timely, able, 17.0 h < 32, earnings below a full deduction → otherwise payable. Search "waiting-week entry" → "Waiting-Week Entries on Unemployment Benefit Claims", whose write adds "one waiting-week entry … for that week". Corroborated by the computation doc ("nothing is payable while the claim carries fewer waiting-week entries than that count").
- Q0 → Q1 (state-derived): "A weekly payment is fixed only after the claim's dependency allowance no longer counts any dependent removed from the record." DA 30.00 = 2 × 15.00 vs dependents_count 1 (persona: daughter moved to her mother's claim). Search "dependency allowance" + "dependents now on record" / "removed" → "Dependency Disallowance on Unemployment Benefit Claims": "issued on a … record whose dependency allowance counts more dependents than are now on record … sets the claim's dependency allowance to the redetermined figure".
- Q0 → Q3 (state-derived): "A weekly payment is issued only after the week being paid carries the claimant's weekly certification." No certification for 2026-09-12. Search "certify" → "Certifying a Week by Phone…" (claimant-side tool; the holiday pay is "the figure the Department values for it, and the agent tells the claimant the amount to enter").
- Q2 → Q1 (state-derived): waiting-week hub "The value of a waiting week is not fixed until the claim's dependency allowance no longer counts any dependent removed from the record."
- Q3 → Q2 (state-derived): phone-certification hub "A week after the first week of a benefit year is certified only after the claim carries a waiting-week entry." (2026-09-12 is the second week; the claim carries none.) Also the waiting-week hub's "The week valued is the latest week certified on the claim at the time the entry is made" makes Q2-before-Q3 necessary for the entry to value 2026-09-05.
- Order: Q1 → Q2 → Q3 → Q0. No pre-solved hop; each hub names only its own tool.

### Two-way counter-proof

- Alternatives excluded by visible text: (i) deducting holiday pay in full or at one half — excluded by the 7.0-hour row ("Some hours, but fewer than 8 … added to the week's earnings"); (ii) program 32-hour threshold / 0.30 share — excluded by federal-separation new-claim row and the recall-date row; (iii) holiday window of 3 months — excluded by the 30-day closure row; (iv) full disallowance (no appeal share) — excluded by "Stands filed or scheduled"; (v) waiting week for 2026-09-12 — excluded by the ordering (certification of week 2 waits on the entry) and by "first otherwise-payable week"; (vi) child-support share 0.5 — status is requested, not active; (vii) child support withholding deducted from this payment — order is only requested and the weekly-payment tool takes "no overpayment offset and no withholding".
- "Do only the one thing": paying 2026-09-12 directly is impossible on the records — the week carries no certification, the claim no waiting-week entry, and the allowance counts a removed dependent; each is a state the weekly-payment hub says must hold. Excluded by visible principles.
- Fall-backs recorded: 390 vs 135; 371 vs 430; 184.00 vs 73.26; 315 vs 477. Factor findability: from record words "dependents on record"/"effective date" (claim), "Child Support Withholding — Current Support Order … requested" (withholding order), "monetary determination date" (claim), "weekly payments issued" (ledger), "Lower Authority Appeal — Monetary Determination … scheduled" (appeal), "earnings_misreported … balance_due" (overpayment), "recall_date" (claim), "federal_separation" (claim), "closed_date" and certifications of the earlier UCFE claim, "holiday_pay" (certification). No computation document announced a variation.
- Blind-side observations (judged after reveal): "Valuing Holiday Pay Reported as Other Pay" lists "Source records: The certifications of the claimant's most recent earlier claim" and "History window: The last 3 calendar months" although its own rate (HQW / 520) reads neither — elements with no effect in the computation as written; factor documents "Partial-Hours Earnings Rates on Weekly Payments", "Dependency Allowance Paid in a Part-Week" and "Disregard Reduction on Weekly Payments after Misreported Earnings" use "counted earnings", a term defined only in the holiday-pay treatment factor; the phone-certification hub title mentions "Weeks with Holiday Pay" (task-1-like situation, but also that policy's own subject).
